note: The cited passages establish the kind of object and its use. Its precise mineral identity remains uncertain.
summary: Genesis names שֹׁהַם among the materials found in Havilah. Exodus describes two stones of this kind engraved with the names of Israel’s sons and mounted in gold on the ephod.

senses.definition: A precious stone traditionally identified as onyx.

evidence.note: In אֶבֶן הַשֹּׁהַם, the noun שֹׁהַם names the kind of stone found in the land.
Two שֹׁהַם stones are engraved with names and mounted in gold on the shoulders of the ephod.
